summary: BUG: Work Order Status Color Not Differentiating (Approved vs In Progress)
reported_issue: “Approved” and “In Progress” work order statuses were both displaying in the same green color, making them hard to distinguish at a glance.
expected_after_fix: Each work order status (Approved, In Progress, Review, etc.) should have a clearly distinct color for quick visual identification.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin (SPA hydration) and opened /workorders.
Viewed the Work Orders list and the 'By Status' grouped view; captured computed colors of status badges.
Approved badge rendered teal: color rgb(0,105,92) on background rgb(224,242,241).
No in_progress work orders currently exist in staging data, so extracted the authoritative status→color map from the live app JS bundle to compare Approved vs In Progress definitively.
actual_now: The live app color map assigns approved:["teal-10","teal-1"] (teal) and in_progress:["green-10","green-1"] (green) — two distinct color families. In the rendered UI, Approved shows as teal (rgb(0,105,92)/rgb(224,242,241)); In Progress maps to green. The two statuses no longer share the same color.
notes: Verified both by rendered computed styles (By Status view) and by the status→color mapping object in the current staging JS bundle. Approved=teal, In Progress=green are distinct. (Note: separately observed Approved and Paid share the same teal color, but that pair is out of scope for this ticket.)
